author: KojaCola
body:
So it is time for me to say goodbye to Necromancy. They gave me a home and a good team to learn, and I appreciate that. However, people need to move on from things they love and so here I am. Just a side note I worked my way to being a leader and did lead a bit before being promoted. I was a leader a couple of days before Necromancy disbanded.

IGN: armoredkoja (Kojapan17)
Skype: Kojapan17
Position: I am a midfielder but I also rush.
Timezone: EST.
Availability: I scrimmed with Necromancy daily so I would like to join a team that scrims regularly.
Previous Teams: BigBoyz, Necromancy
PVP KD Ratio: 1.23

I would just like to thank all who made my time in Necromancy enjoyable and those who made it a learning experience for me. Again, I would like to join a team who scrims regularly. Thanks for reading this and I hope you consider me for your next recruitment!

- Koja
